status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. Dorchester County and Dorchester County Economic Development identify Google's two Dorchester County data center campuses at Pine Hill Business Campus in Ridgeville and Winding Woods Commerce Park in St. George, and local economic-development notices say Google broke ground on both campuses on 2024-09-26 and that the projects were under active construction on 2025-10-13. Google's October 13, 2025 company post says its $9 billion South Carolina investment supports continued construction of two Dorchester County sites. SCPSC/Santee Cooper records show 230-kV transmission approvals for an unnamed industrial data-center consumer in Dorchester County; those utility records support data-center load development but do not independently name Google or prove energization. No certificate of occupancy, commissioning, or live-service evidence was located in this refresh.
evidence_grade: B - official/company and county economic-development sources confirm Google site work/construction; utility approvals support related data-center load, but public PSC records reviewed do not name Google and no energization/live-service proof was located.

actions.government_body: South Carolina Governor / state economic-development announcement
actions.result_status: State announcement says Google planned two new data-center campuses in Dorchester County, at Pine Hill in Ridgeville and Winding Woods in St. George, representing a $2 billion investment and 200 operational jobs across the new sites.
actions.access_caveat: Announcement is not local zoning, building, environmental, or utility approval.
actions.evidence_note: State/company announcement kept separate from government permits.

actions.result_status: Dorchester County Economic Development reported that Google broke ground on two new Dorchester County data center campuses, representing a $2 billion investment, at Pine Hill Business Campus in Ridgeville and Winding Woods Commerce Park in St. George; the notice also reported 200 new Dorchester County jobs and approximately 1,200 long-term construction jobs.
actions.access_caveat: Economic-development notice confirms groundbreaking/site work but is not a building permit, certificate of occupancy, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Supports status upgrade from announced/local process to site work-construction.

actions.government_body: Dorchester County Economic Development / Google company announcement
actions.result_status: Dorchester County Economic Development said Google's two Dorchester County data center campus projects were under active construction, and Google's company post said a new $9 billion South Carolina investment through 2027 would support continued construction of two Dorchester County sites.
actions.access_caveat: Investment/construction update; not a permit, CO, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms construction remained active after the 2024 groundbreaking.

actions.government_body: South Carolina Public Service Commission / Central Electric Power Cooperative proceeding
actions.result_status: Official testimony in Docket 2025-275-E describes a data-center project and two radial 230-kV transmission lines in St. George, Dorchester County; the accessible testimony excerpt does not name Google, so the customer identity is not attributed beyond the separately announced location.
actions.access_caveat: Testimony identifies a related data-center project but does not by itself establish Google identity or building approval.
actions.evidence_note: Utility application/testimony, not data-center construction authorization.

actions.government_body: South Carolina Public Service Commission / Santee Cooper
actions.result_status: PSC Order 2026-83 in Docket 2025-274-E granted Santee Cooper a CECPCN for the Indian Field-Sugar Hill #1 and #2 230-kV lines and a new Sugar Hill 230-kV Substation in Dorchester County. The order states the project will support electrical service for an industrial data-center consumer of Edisto Electric Cooperative and notes anticipated construction beginning in May 2026, with earlier clearing authorized.
actions.access_caveat: Official utility order identifies an industrial data-center consumer but not Google by name; it is utility infrastructure authorization, not a data-center building permit or energization proof.
actions.evidence_note: Supports Dorchester County data-center load development while keeping customer attribution separate.

actions.result_status: PSC order 2026-84 granted a Certificate of Environmental Compatibility and Public Convenience and Necessity for two radial 230-kV lines and associated facilities in Dorchester County. The order title does not identify Google; it is not a data-center building permit or proof of energization.
actions.access_caveat: Order index is official; customer/project-specific attachment attribution to Google was not established from the accessible title.
actions.evidence_note: Utility infrastructure approval kept separate from land-use/building approval.

actions.action_type: county data-center fact sheet / utility-service context
actions.result_status: County fact sheet identifies the Pine Hill Business Campus and Winding Woods Commerce Park Google data centers, says they are being built in phases, describes planned/supplied water sources for each site, and states the facilities will bring 200 full-time jobs and 1,200 long-term construction jobs.
actions.access_caveat: Fact sheet is an official county public-information page, not a permit ledger or CO/energization record.
actions.evidence_note: Confirms current county view of phased construction and local utility-service context.
